$comment: DEMO / NON-PRODUCTION PRODUCT FIXTURE (VR3-01). Every name, value, cost, date and document here is synthetic and exists only to demonstrate Product behaviour. It is not calculation authority, a quotation or a real client record. Transcribed from the accepted VR3-00 fixture specification artifacts/VR3-00-global-design-audit/06-demo-fixtures/demo-project-fixtures.md; the counts, filenames, buildings, areas, source relations, questions, conflicts and media ids are invariants of that specification and are re-proved mechanically by src/fixtures/__tests__/vr3-demo-projects.test.ts. Prose is not stored here: every user-visible sentence is an i18n key (rule 36), resolved DE/EN from src/i18n. Numbers are decimal STRINGS, never JSON numbers, so no float ever enters the model. VR3 PORTFOLIO EXTENSION (Projects portfolio rebuild): each project now also carries a `portfolio` block — the ISO country code, postcode, street, lifecycle status, created/last-modified/next-client-meeting timestamps and the declared portfolio area metric. Those fields are PRESENTATION identity for the Projects register; they never enter the calculation, the Option or the client output. `owner` now carries the responsible manager's full first name and surname, because the portfolio filters on a person and initials are not a person.
